description: List the newest Angebote, Kostenvoranschläge and Auftragsbestätigungen of the connected facturo account with validity, totals, items, PDF links and when they were last emailed. Filter by client, document type or text. Use it to find the Angebot an Auftragsbestätigung confirms (source_offer_number) or to copy an earlier offer. Each row's status is open, accepted, declined, expired (past its validity) or issued (an Auftragsbestätigung). The PDF links are for the user to open.

search.description: Matches offer number, client name, reference lines or an item description
